subject.title: fix(ci): ignore profiling-only resource gate failures

question: Should the draft PR be repaired in place to require passing phase results before tolerating profiled resource-only failures?
rationale: The intended product direction is clear, but the patch changes release-gate behavior and is maintainer-labeled/draft, so a maintainer should decide whether to repair this PR or replace it with a narrower equivalent patch.

options.title: Repair this PR in place
options.body: Add the phase-result guard and regression test on this branch, then rerun the focused Kova helper tests and changed checks before review.

options.title: Replace with a narrower patch
options.body: Close or supersede the draft only if maintainers prefer a smaller adapter-only implementation with the same fail-closed contract.

options.title: Defer the gate exception
options.body: Keep the linked issue open if maintainers want live Kova artifact proof before changing release validation behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR in place
recommendation.body: Add the phase-result guard and regression test on this branch, then rerun the focused Kova helper tests and changed checks before review.
